Sam (product): Quick sync — drafting a compact spec for tenant-level guardrails: pin semantics, acceptance criteria, and canary/AB experiment playbook. Need sharp rollback triggers and test plan.

Jia (eng): Can you surface concrete customer asks here? per-tenant vs per-route pinning makes a big difference for routing impl.

Sam (product): Good call. Examples: a) large customer requests full-route pin to v2 for 2 weeks; b) beta customers want 5% traffic to model-experiment; c) emergency pin when a competitor regression appears. We should support per-tenant+per-route, percent-based, and expiry by default.

Marco (eng-runtime): Runtime notes: +1 for per-route pin with TTL. We can evaluate flags: resolution order -> explicit route pin, tenant default pin, global default. Rollback hooks we can trigger from metric policy. Proposed automated triggers: error-rate > 3x baseline for 5m, p95 latency +200ms sustained 10m, cost/req +30% over baseline for 15m.

Priya (design): UX: pin modal should show: current traffic split, estimated cost delta, predicted latency delta, and an "auto-expire" checkbox. Mockups: https://figma.redwood/xyz (will attach). Make "apply pin" require owner confirmation.

Connor (sre): Add fallback policy: if model variant fails, fall back to configured compatible variant (quantized or older model) automatically and page on severe errors. Canary ramp suggestion: 0 -> 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100% with wait windows of 10m, 20m, 30m, 1h and automated health checks between steps.

Sam (product): Draft acceptance criteria (initial):
- API: create/update/delete pin for tenant+route, accepts percent and expires_at.
- Resolution: routing honors pin at request time deterministically.
- Safety: automated rollback triggers fire and revert to previous (or fallback) within SLO.
- Observability: telemetry events for pin.create/pin.update/pin.delete plus per-pin metrics (latency, error-rate, cost).
- Audit: all pin actions recorded with actor and timestamp.

Jia (eng): Example config for spec (we'll validate schema in tests):
```
{
  "tenant": "acme",
  "route": "/v1/generate",
  "model": "redwood-7b-v2",
  "percent": 5,
  "expires_at": "2026-04-15T00:00:00Z"
}
```

Marco (eng-runtime): Telemetry we'll emit: `pin.applied`, `pin.rollback`, `pin.traffic.sample` with tags {tenant, route, model, pin_id}. Need those in the acceptance tests.

Anika (pm): I'll coordinate pilot with CS (customer A) once alpha is ready. Checklist for pilot: audit logs enabled, KMS access verified for private deployments, and a rollback-authority defined (who can force-revert).

Connor (sre): Runbook (short):
- Detect trigger -> attempt automatic rollback to pinned previous model or fallback
- Notify on-call + product owner
- If auto-rollback fails, run manual mitigation steps (scale up fallback, throttle traffic)

Sam (product): Proposed rollout: RFC -> 2-week internal alpha (prod-separated tenants) -> pilot with 1-2 customers -> general release behind feature flag. Need reviewers and owners: @Jia, @Marco, @Priya, @Connor, @Anika.

Jia (eng): I'll draft the spec + unit/e2e test matrix. Key tests: deterministic routing with overlapping pins, expiry behavior, canary ramp health checks, metrics gating.

Priya (design): I'll produce the modal and pin history UI by next Wed.

Connor (sre): I'll draft rollback runbook and health-checks for canary gating.

Sam (product): Action items (short):
- Jia: spec + test plan by Fri EOD
- Marco: runtime API + telemetry contract by Mon
- Priya: mockups by Wed
- Connor: rollback runbook + gating thresholds by Mon
- Anika: pilot ops checklist and customer communications

ops-bot: Deployment note: scheduled canary-config job queued for 2026-03-22T02:30:00Z.

Sam (product): Thanks — added to RFC reviewers. :thumbsup:
